screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's learn to stop and think before we buy.

screens.title: Stop and think

cards.caption: Stop before you buy. Nothing runs away.
Ask yourself: do I really want this?

screens.penny: I curl up and think when I'm not sure, {name}.

screens.prompt: You see a toy you like. What is the first thing to do?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Stopping first gives your brain a moment.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! It helps to stop first. The toy will still be there.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about the first step again, {name}.

screens.prompt: You waited a day and you still want it. Is it okay to buy it?
screens.rightMessage: That's right, {name}! Buying is fine when you've thought it through.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Spending is okay. Stopping first just makes it your choice.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about waiting a day again, {name}.

screens.story: Tom sees a shiny toy at the shop. He wants it this second.

options.label: Stop and think for a minute
options.outcome: Tom waits a minute. He remembers he already has one at home, and keeps his coins.

options.label: Buy it straight away
options.outcome: Tom buys it. At home he finds one just like it. His coins are gone.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A minute of thinking saved his coins.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A quick stop would have reminded him about the one at home.

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: Stop and think. Then you choose.
